Package org.bsc.langgraph4j

Class StateGraph<State extends AgentState>

java.lang.Object
org.bsc.langgraph4j.StateGraph<State>
Type Parameters:
State - the type of the state associated with the graph
All Implemented Interfaces:
GraphDefinition<State>, LG4JLoggable
Direct Known Subclasses:
MessagesStateGraph
public non-sealed class StateGraph<State extends AgentState> extends Object implements GraphDefinition<State>, LG4JLoggable
Represents a state graph with nodes and edges.

    • reduce

      public <Output> Output reduce(GraphDefinition.Reducer<State,Output> reducer)
      Applies a reducer function to process the nodes and edges of this graph.

      This method allows external processing of the graph structure by applying a custom reduction function that receives all nodes and edges.

      Specified by:
      reduce in interface GraphDefinition<State extends AgentState>
      Type Parameters:
      Output - the type of output produced by the reducer
      Parameters:
      reducer - the reducer function to apply
      Returns:
